platforms.label: YouTube (Short)
platforms.title: Why Is Jesus Called Immanuel?
platforms.description:
A frightened king told God no. God answered anyway.

About 700 years before Jesus, King Ahaz of Judah, from King David's family, was afraid of war. God said "fear not" and offered him any sign. Ahaz refused. In that same war he begged a foreign king: "I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me" (2 Kings 16:7).

God gave the sign anyway:
"Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel." (Isaiah 7:14)

Seven hundred years later it came true. An angel told Joseph, another son of David, to fear not, and the child was named JESUS, "for he shall save his people from their sins" (Matthew 1:21). Matthew says the name Emmanuel means "God with us" (Matthew 1:23).

One king begged a king to save him. This child saves.

Old Testament promises that came true in Jesus, episode 2.

platforms.label: YouTube (Long-form 16:9)
platforms.title: Why Is Jesus Called Immanuel? The King Who Told God No (Isaiah 7:14)
platforms.description:
Why is Jesus called Immanuel? The famous Christmas promise began with a frightened king who said no to God.

About 700 years before Jesus, King Ahaz of Judah, from King David's family, was afraid of war. Two armies were coming. God said "fear not" and offered him any sign he wanted. Ahaz refused. In that same war he begged the king of Assyria: "I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me" (2 Kings 16:7), and paid him with silver and gold from God's own house (2 Kings 16:8).

God gave the sign anyway:
"Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel." (Isaiah 7:14)

Seven hundred years later it came true. Mary, a virgin, was with child by the Holy Spirit. An angel told Joseph, another son of David, to fear not, and said the child's name would be JESUS, "for he shall save his people from their sins" (Matthew 1:21). Joseph obeyed. Matthew says the name Emmanuel means "God with us" (Matthew 1:23).

One son of David begged a foreign king to save him. Another son of David obeyed, and the child he named saves. God with us: as a baby, at the cross where He died for our sins, and risen on the third day (1 Corinthians 15:3-4). He promised: "I am with you alway" (Matthew 28:20).

Old Testament promises that came true in Jesus, episode 2. Episode 1: Why Was Jesus Born in Bethlehem?

redteam:
VERDICT: REVISE

- tiktok + instagram: "Watch to the end." is a templated engagement line, not the text's own hook. Cut it; end on the real open question instead (instagram already has "What was it, and when did it come true?" - keep that, drop "Watch to the end"; tiktok: end on "Isaiah 7:14 was God's answer.").
- youtube_long: "Two armies were coming." is true (Isaiah 7:1, Rezin and Pekah) but the film never says it; fine to keep, but cite it: "Two armies were coming (Isaiah 7:1)."
- youtube_long: "any sign he wanted" slightly paraphrases Isaiah 7:11 ("ask it either in the depth, or in the height above"). Acceptable as a paraphrase in narrator voice; do NOT put it in quote marks.
- youtube_short / facebook: "About 700 years before Jesus" is a round figure (c. 735 BC); "About" keeps it honest. Keep "About".
- All KJV quotes checked verbatim: Isaiah 7:14 exact; 2 Kings 16:7 "I am thy servant and thy son: come up, and save me" exact; Matthew 1:21 "for he shall save his people from their sins" exact. No overclaim found: the copy never says Ahaz was punished, never calls Joseph the father, and frames Ahaz vs Joseph as a contrast, not a fulfilment.
- Titles are honest: "Why Is Jesus Called Immanuel?" is fully answered by the film (Matthew 1:23). No clickbait.
